name: Choices Picker
tagline: A Choice or Multi-Select Choice column as a keyboard-accessible picker.
summary:
Shows every option of a Choice or Multi-Select Choice column at once, as pills or a stacked list with the selected ones marked, instead of a dropdown that hides the selection behind a summary line. One control handles both column types, and it uses the option colours already set in Dataverse.

Every option is reachable from the keyboard. In a canvas app there is no column metadata, so the option list is supplied through the `options` property.

presets.name: Single choice
presets.description: A Choice column shown as pills, one option selected, its options and colours read from the column itself, as on a model-driven form: Options is left empty.

presets.name: Multi-select
presets.description: A Multi-Select Choice column, three of six selected, its choices given in the Options property — the route a canvas app needs, and the way to relabel or narrow a column's list.

presets.name: Stacked list
presets.description: The same multi-select column as Fluent checkboxes instead of pills.

presets.name: Nothing selected
presets.description: The empty state, with option colours switched off, over the same Choice column as Single choice.
